description: Architects Registration Board - Correction Notice to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2264/5 of 24.01.2022 (E Only)
reasoning: This gazette content is a correction notice from the Architects Registration Board of Sri Lanka Institute of Architects, publishing a list of individuals registered as Chartered Architects. It contains professional registrations with names, addresses, and registration details, but does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any specialized categories (Types 4-9). This falls under professional/academic appointments in a specialized field (architecture), making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
